answer_1.quote: ActionStudio integrates a novel critique-and-filter pipeline ... The resulting dataset, ACTIONSTUDIO-98K, comprises 98,000 high-quality trajectories ... Models trained with ActionStudio achieve new state-of-the-art results on NexusRaven and the CRM Agent Benchmark.
answer_1.outputs: agent trajectories consisting of dialogue turns, tool calls, observations, and user feedback

answer_2.quote: We evaluate model performance using precision, recall, and F1-score metrics for both function retrieval and argument inference tasks ... The CRM Agent Benchmark reports average accuracy.

answer_3.quote: Prior work has explored leveraging LLMs-like GPT-4-class models for automatically evaluating and filtering trajectory quality ... We augment the LLM evaluator with a small set of curated exemplars ... This simple yet effective in-context guidance leads to more fine-grained, human-aligned evaluations.

answer_4.quote: We commissioned an independent third-party annotation provider to audit a uniformly random sample of 150 trajectories ... Annotators followed the four rubric items defined in §3.1.3 - correctness, hallucination, tool-use appropriateness, and overall response quality.
